examples.text: Jigoro Kano verkreeg na zijn dood de hoogste graad, de 12e dan, een brede witte band. Deze graad is exclusief voorbehouden aan de stichter van het judo.
examples.translation: Jigoro Kano received after his death the highest degree, the twelfth dan, a broad white band. This degree is exclusively reserved for the founder of judo.
examples.english: Jigoro Kano received after his death the highest degree, the twelfth dan, a broad white band. This degree is exclusively reserved for the founder of judo.
